fields.name: info_download
fields.label: About the Download links
fields.value: As the iTorrents .torrent download link on this site is known to fail from time to time, we suggest using the magnet link as a fallback. The BTCache and Torrage services are not supported because they require additional user interaction (a captcha for BTCache and a download button on Torrage.)

fields.name: info_top100
fields.label: About the top100 selection
fields.value: TPB indexer uses top100_recent for its TEST and keyword-less searches. However TPB will often only include Movies and TV in its top100_recent list which makes setting up Lidarr for Audio or other similar *Arr apps problematic. By changing the top100 selector you will make the indexer use a more focused top100 for the category group your *Arr app uses.

fields.name: info_uploader

Note: this is the username of the Uploader and not the Groupname that often show up at the end of TPB titles, eg -MeGusta.
